pending_commit.commit_message: drm/evdi: Add enable_cursor_blending module param Parameter is used to enable or disable cursor compositioning on user supplied framebuffer during EVDI_GRABPIX ioctl. This adds possibility to get framebuffer content without cursor and composite cursor in user space application. By default cursor compositioning is enabled. drm/evdi: Add drm cursor events This is new api which sends notifications about changed cursor. User can disable cursor blending inside evdi and use drm events instead. This method is recomended as previous solution was generating full screen changes when cursor has changed. camera3_test: support non-standard color bars pattern Not every sensor supports the color bars test pattern defined by the Android standard. With this change we consider the test passed if the captured frame matches any listed pattern. Partners as well as developers can add a pattern when it is required in the future projects.
